summary: Genuine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct Q4_K_M inference on the custom out-of-core streamed CPU decoder, after re-downloading a COMPLETE, SHA-verified GGUF (the prior on-disk artifact was a 47%-truncated partial; see qwen2_7b_truncated_artifact_and_streamed_health_2026-11-24.json). The streamed backend executes the real 7B including its UNTIED output.weight (Q6_K), producing coherent greedy text, under enforced RLIMIT_AS down to 256 MiB at ~79 MB peak RSS. Teacher-forced logit comparison against the pinned llama.cpp resident reference shows top-1 agreement at all 8 positions with per-position RMSE 0.148-0.229 and zero non-finite logits (same permissible FP32-path precision band as all smaller models). Resident chat (generated text) is RAM-admission-blocked on this 6.7 GB host (needs ~4.97 GB); the resident reference logits for parity were obtained via the logit-diff mmap path. No production source code changed.
classification: COMPLETE (evidence-backed) for streamed 7B inference, untied-output execution, numerical parity, two-core affinity, and 2048/1024/512/256 MiB bounded memory. Resident generated-text reference BLOCKED by host RAM (documented, not fabricated).

download_and_verification.verify: VERIFY_OK (exact size match AND exact SHA-256 match; fail-closed gate passed before any inference)

Coherent greedy output and top-1 parity with the resident reference confirm the untied projection is executed correctly (no fallback to token embeddings).

io.note: Authenticated run bypasses the app cache (0 hits/0 misses): every weight block is re-read AND re-hashed per token. Decode ~5.15 s/token is SHA-bound (hashing ~4.68 GB/token); TTFT ~31 s is the first (partly cold) full weight stream. OS page cache (separate from app cache) holds the 4.68 GB file, so decode reads are warm.

bounded_memory_ladder.params: authenticated, taskset -c 0,1, greedy, ctx 128, workspace 48 MB, max_tokens 2
bounded_memory_ladder.conclusion: A 4.68 GB model runs genuine authenticated streamed inference under an enforced 256 MiB RLIMIT_AS at ~79 MB peak RSS. The memory floor is vocab/tokenizer-bound (152,064 tokens) plus workspace/KV, NOT weights. The 2 GB process-memory target is massively satisfied for this model+workload. WSL2 RLIMIT_AS is NOT a claim about physical 2 GB RAM hardware.
bounded_memory_ladder.lower_than_256_not_tested: 256 MiB is the lowest limit exercised; smaller limits not probed.

plan_estimate.finding: plan refuses with 'minimum 64-token streamed context does not fit budget' when --workspace-mb is the 8 MB default, INDEPENDENT of --max-ram-mb, because workspace is min'd with workspace_budget_bytes (streamed_plan.rs:118-128) and the 7B's 64-token KV (~7.3 MB) plus fixed workspace exceeds 8 MB. With --workspace-mb 64 the plan succeeds. This is correct conservative behavior, NOT a defect; estimated_additional_bytes (~58 MB) is consistent with the measured ~79 MB peak RSS.

teacher_forced_parity.method: logit-diff --teacher-forced --max-tokens 8 --ctx 128 --threads 2 --top-k 10 --workspace-mb 48 (resident greedy tokens fed to streamed so every position shares a prefix)
teacher_forced_parity.max_rel_err_note: Per-position max_rel_err is large (10^3-10^5) purely due to the tiny-denominator relative-error artifact (rel_denominator_floor 1e-6) on near-zero logits; absolute/RMSE metrics are the meaningful ones.
teacher_forced_parity.interpretation: Streamed custom decoder matches the pinned llama.cpp resident argmax at every teacher-forced position for the real 7B, with per-position RMSE in the same FP32-path precision band observed on Stories/Qwen-0.5B/1.5B/Llama-3.2-1B (q8_0 rmse 0.185 > here). Zero non-finite logits. 8/8 top-1 agreement (cleaner than smaller models' occasional near-tie flips). No structural numerical defect; no code/tolerance change.
